summary_en: Ordinary dividend increased ¥10/share (¥130 → ¥140). Special dividend ¥20/share. Total FY9/26 year-end dividend ¥160/share. Ordinary dividend payout ratio target ≥50%. Rationale: H1 FY9/26 results exceeded guidance; 9M cumulative sales and all profit tiers forecast record highs.
title_en: Notice of revision to dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Career Design Center announced a revision to its FY9/26 (fiscal year ending September 2026) dividend forecast on June 16, 2026. The company raised the ordinary dividend by ¥10 per share from the prior forecast of ¥130 to ¥140 per share. Additionally, it announced a special dividend of ¥20 per share, bringing the total year-end dividend to ¥160 per share, compared with the prior revised forecast of ¥130 per share ordinary dividend only. The company cited strong H1 FY9/26 results that exceeded the initial guidance, and 9M cumulative period results for both revenue and all profit tiers tracking to record highs. The company maintains an ordinary dividend payout ratio target of at least 50% and stated that it will continue implementing dividends in light of business trends and financial conditions. The special dividend reflects gratitude to shareholders for their ongoing support in enabling the company to achieve business growth despite uncertain operating conditions.
